t: The Easyfix styrene-free polyester resin is a reliable bonded anchor, offering a general purpose fixing solution for professional trades. Its low odour and expansion-free properties make it ideal for structural fixes, such as securing awnings, balconies, and storage racking in both solid and hollow substrates. This versatile chemical anchor even works in non-cracked concrete and water-filled holes, excluding seawater. The patented self-opening system ensures easy dosage and multiple uses, promoting efficiency on site.
